channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Trump threatens to sue Trevor Noah over Epstein joke at Grammys: 'Going to have some fun with you!'
item.description: President Trump called the 68th Grammy Awards on Sunday 'virtually unwatchable.' Still, he watched enough to take issue with host Trevor Noah's Jeffrey Epstein joke.

item.title: 'Today' host Savannah Guthrie's mom possibly kidnapped in middle of night, authorities say
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, 84, was last seen Saturday. Detectives said the scene at her home was "very concerning" and on Monday afternoon the department said it was investigating her disappearance as a possible kidnapping.

item.title: Measles cases grow in SoCal; one infected person flew into LAX, spent hours at Disney park
item.description: Orange County confirmed a measles case from an international traveler who visited Disney California Adventure Park. L.A. County confirmed its third case in a resident who went to a Sherman Oaks restaurant.

item.title: Real, fake or overblown? Sorting fact from fiction in fraud allegations surrounding Newsom, California
item.description: Fraud allegations are increasingly being deployed as a political weapon against Newsom, a leading Trump critic and a potential 2028 Democratic presidential contender.

item.title: Panel tosses ex-UCLA doctor's sex abuse conviction; lawyers weren't told of juror's 'limited English'
item.description: In October 2022, after a two-month jury trial, UCLA doctor James Heaps was convicted of three counts of sexual battery by fraud and two counts of sexual penetration involving two patients. That conviction has been overturned.

item.title: L.A. parents who decapitated two of their kids, forced siblings to view the bodies, are sentenced
item.description: A Lancaster couple who decapitated their 12- and 13-year-old children in 2020 were sentenced to life without parole Monday.

item.title: 'Melania' director Brett Ratner turns up in Epstein files, again
item.description: Director Brett Ratner is once again in the headlines after debuting his documentary, 'Melania,' showing up in the latest Department of Justice batch of released Epstein files.

item.title: Bass preaches 'unity' in L.A. ahead of 2028 Olympics during State of the City address
item.description: The mayor also that Angelenos need to unite in the face of immigration raids, homelessness crisis and the 2025 fires.
